purpose: If the initial token-only capacity experiment fails at2000updates, test whether exposing supplied intramotif distances improves learnability without changing the frozen generator.
prerequisite: Both original adapter_only and full2000update arms complete and fail the predeclared training capacity gate. Preserve their failed results and run their planned designability assays regardless.
conditioning: Retain the identical29feature token adapter. Add supplied fragment CA distances only:16Gaussian radial features centered0,2,...30A with width2A, plus d/(d+10). A17to64to(n_layers*n_heads) SiLU MLP adds attention biases only within known motif residue pairs. Output linear zero initialized. No scaffold atoms, full-context fragment codes or output-latent clamping. Token latent inputs retain information beyond distances, including chirality.
training: Entire pretrained generator frozen; train token and distance adapters together at3e-4 with the original optimizer/schedule/EMA/dropout/history settings. Same32training families/288fragments,seed2026100231,batches64/32/16/8,2000updates. Compare against the completed token-only adapter arm; identical data/fragment/noise/time/dropout/history traces required.
controls: Original null/historical and batching parity at initialization; fragment-dropped samples at every endpoint match the frozen generator; every endpoint includes four actual-checkpoint rigid-pose controls with latent max error<=1e-4. No known-pair bias outside supplied motif. CPU parity/gradient/dropout/rigid-pose tests required.
resource_gate: OneRTX40update profile before full training; finite gradients, frozen-weight identity, all sampler/pose controls, peak reserved<=75GiB. Full allocation follows measured runtime. No additional arm or parameter sweep.
evaluation: Same50Euler/AE3,all32training/16development families,four noises,500diagnostic and2000primary,conditioned/null branches. Exact earlier evaluation seeds and full unfiltered saved output audit. Capacity passes only if conditioned-minus-null raw motif<=1A/coarse-valid lower95percent family interval>0. Also compare absolute and paired results with token-only control; no generalization claim from training capacity.
designability: Same36backbone/288refold fixed-motif sequence design assay as the original arms, requiring one SAME valid refold with global scTM>.5 and motif dRMS/proper-rotation CA RMSD<=1A. All technical completions receive this assay without filtering.
